param: Ψ Total recruitment into susceptible population (paper uses C; equations use Ψ).
θ Proportion of men among recruits (paper uses h; equations use θ).
γ Proportion of heterosexual men among male recruits (paper uses c; equations use γ).
p Proportion of diagnosed/initiating individuals who enter ART treatment T.
μ Natural mortality rate (paper uses l; equations use μ).
α Departure/diagnosis rate from untreated infected compartments into treatment decision (to T with fraction p, to A with fraction 1-p).
δ Progression to AIDS while on ART (treatment failure / resistance).
d AIDS-induced mortality rate.
λ_h Force of infection for susceptible homosexual men S_h (exclusive homosexual contact).
λ_m Force of infection acting on susceptible women S_w from heterosexual men (exclusive heterosexual contact).
λ_hw Force of infection acting on susceptible women S_w from homosexual men (bisexual contact).
λ_w Force of infection acting on susceptible heterosexual men S_m from women (exclusive heterosexual contact).
λ_hm Force of infection acting on susceptible heterosexual men S_m from homosexual men (bisexual contact).
b_s Transmission probability parameter for exclusive heterosexual contact (paper notation b_s).
b_h Transmission probability parameter for exclusive homosexual contact (paper notation b_h).
b_hw Transmission probability parameter for bisexual contact homosexual men → women (paper notation b_hw).
b_hm Transmission probability parameter for bisexual contact homosexual men → heterosexual men (paper notation b_hm).
c_s Rate/number of sexual partners for exclusive heterosexual contact (paper notation c_s).
c_h Rate/number of sexual partners for exclusive homosexual contact (paper notation c_h).
c_hw Rate/number of sexual partners for bisexual contact homosexual men → women (paper notation c_hw).
c_hm Rate/number of sexual partners for bisexual contact homosexual men → heterosexual men (paper notation c_hm).
